question:
Hongsheng Factory produces three types of products, I, II, and III, which all undergo processing in two steps, A and B. Step A has two machines, A1 and A2, while step B has three machines, B1, B2, and B3. It is known that product I can be processed on either type of A machine, product II can be processed on any type of A machine but can only be processed on machine B2 in step B, and product III can only be processed on machine B2 in step B. Products II and III can only be processed on machines A2 and B2 in step A and B, respectively. The processing time per unit product and other relevant data are shown in Table 1-20. How should the production plan be arranged to maximize profit for the factory?

Table 1-20
\begin{tabular}{|c|c|c|c|c|c|}
\hline \multirow{2}{*}{ Machine } & \multicolumn{3}{|c|}{ Products } & \multirow{2}{*}{ Effective Machine Hours } & \multirow{2}{*}{\begin{tabular}{c} 
Machine Processing Fee \\
/(元/h)
\end{tabular}} \\
\hline & I & II & III & & \\
\hline A1 & 5 & 10 & $2+4$ & 6000 & 0.05 \\
\hline A2 & 7 & 9 & 12 & 10000 & 0.03 \\
\hline B1 & 6 & 8 & & 4000 & 0.06 \\
\hline B2 & 4 & & 11 & 7000 & 0.11 \\
\hline B3 & 7 & & & 4000 & 0.05 \\
\hline Raw Material Cost/(元/件) & 0.25 & 0.35 & 0.50 & & \\
\hline Selling Price/(元/件) & 1.25 & 2.00 & 2.80 & & \\
\hline
\end{tabular}

"""
Production planning / product-mix MILP for Hongsheng Factory.

Decision variables (all continuous, non-negative; units = number of items):
  x[I, A1]  : units of product I processed on machine A1 in step A
  x[I, A2]  : units of product I processed on machine A2 in step A
  x[II, A2] : units of product II processed on machine A2 in step A
  x[III, A2]: units of product III processed on machine A2 in step A
  y[I, B1]  : units of product I processed on machine B1 in step B
  y[I, B2]  : units of product I processed on machine B2 in step B
  y[I, B3]  : units of product I processed on machine B3 in step B
  y[II, B2] : units of product II processed on machine B2 in step B
  y[III, B2]: units of product III processed on machine B2 in step B

Objective (maximize): total revenue from selling finished products
  minus raw-material cost minus machine processing fees.

Constraints:
  (1) Step-A capacity on A1: 5*x[I,A1] <= 6000
  (2) Step-A capacity on A2: 7*x[I,A2] + 9*x[II,A2] + 12*x[III,A2] <= 10000
  (3) Step-B capacity on B1: 6*y[I,B1] <= 4000
  (4) Step-B capacity on B2: 4*y[I,B2] + 11*y[III,B2] <= 7000
  (5) Step-B capacity on B3: 7*y[I,B3] <= 4000
  (6) Flow balance product I:  x[I,A1] + x[I,A2] = y[I,B1] + y[I,B2] + y[I,B3]
  (7) Flow balance product II: x[II,A2] = y[II,B2]
  (8) Flow balance product III:x[III,A2] = y[III,B2]
"""

import pyomo.environ as pyo

DATA = {
    # Products
    "products": ["I", "II", "III"],
    # Step-A machine assignments: (product, machine) pairs that are allowed
    "A_pairs": [("I", "A1"), ("I", "A2"), ("II", "A2"), ("III", "A2")],
    # Step-B machine assignments: (product, machine) pairs that are allowed
    "B_pairs": [("I", "B1"), ("I", "B2"), ("I", "B3"), ("II", "B2"), ("III", "B2")],
    # Processing time per unit product on each (product, machine) pair, hours/item
    "time_A": {
        ("I", "A1"): 5,
        ("I", "A2"): 7,
        ("II", "A2"): 9,
        ("III", "A2"): 12,
    },
    "time_B": {
        ("I", "B1"): 6,
        ("I", "B2"): 4,
        ("I", "B3"): 7,
        ("II", "B2"): 8,
        ("III", "B2"): 11,
    },
    # Effective machine hours available
    "hours_A": {"A1": 6000, "A2": 10000},
    "hours_B": {"B1": 4000, "B2": 7000, "B3": 4000},
    # Machine processing fee, yuan per hour
    "fee_A": {"A1": 0.05, "A2": 0.03},
    "fee_B": {"B1": 0.06, "B2": 0.11, "B3": 0.05},
    # Raw material cost, yuan per item
    "raw_cost": {"I": 0.25, "II": 0.35, "III": 0.50},
    # Selling price, yuan per item
    "price": {"I": 1.25, "II": 2.00, "III": 2.80},
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    # Sets
    model.P = pyo.Set(initialize=d["products"])
    model.AP = pyo.Set(initialize=d["A_pairs"], dimen=2)
    model.BP = pyo.Set(initialize=d["B_pairs"], dimen=2)
    model.MA = pyo.Set(initialize=list(d["hours_A"].keys()))
    model.MB = pyo.Set(initialize=list(d["hours_B"].keys()))

    # Decision variables
    model.x = pyo.Var(model.AP, domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    model.y = pyo.Var(model.BP, domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    # Objective: maximize profit
    def obj_rule(m):
        revenue = sum(d["price"][p] * m.y[p, mb] for (p, mb) in m.BP)
        raw = sum(d["raw_cost"][p] * m.y[p, mb] for (p, mb) in m.BP)
        fee_a = sum(
            d["fee_A"][ma] * d["time_A"][p, ma] * m.x[p, ma]
            for (p, ma) in m.AP
        )
        fee_b = sum(
            d["fee_B"][mb] * d["time_B"][p, mb] * m.y[p, mb]
            for (p, mb) in m.BP
        )
        return revenue - raw - fee_a - fee_b

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.maximize)

    # (1)-(2) Step-A capacity constraints
    def cap_A_rule(m, ma):
        return sum(
            d["time_A"][p, ma] * m.x[p, ma]
            for (p, mm) in m.AP
            if mm == ma
        ) <= d["hours_A"][ma]

    model.cap_A = pyo.Constraint(model.MA, rule=cap_A_rule)

    # (3)-(5) Step-B capacity constraints
    def cap_B_rule(m, mb):
        return sum(
            d["time_B"][p, mb] * m.y[p, mb]
            for (p, mm) in m.BP
            if mm == mb
        ) <= d["hours_B"][mb]

    model.cap_B = pyo.Constraint(model.MB, rule=cap_B_rule)

    # (6) Flow balance product I
    def bal_I_rule(m):
        return (
            m.x["I", "A1"] + m.x["I", "A2"]
            == m.y["I", "B1"] + m.y["I", "B2"] + m.y["I", "B3"]
        )

    model.bal_I = pyo.Constraint(rule=bal_I_rule)

    # (7) Flow balance product II
    def bal_II_rule(m):
        return m.x["II", "A2"] == m.y["II", "B2"]

    model.bal_II = pyo.Constraint(rule=bal_II_rule)

    # (8) Flow balance product III
    def bal_III_rule(m):
        return m.x["III", "A2"] == m.y["III", "B2"]

    model.bal_III = pyo.Constraint(rule=bal_III_rule)

    return model

import pyomo.environ as pyo

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# DATA: every numeric value taken from the problem statement / Table 1-20.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
DATA = {
    # --- Product index labels (Table 1-20 header "Products I, II, III") ---
    "products": ["I", "II", "III"],

    # --- Step-A machines (text: "Step A has two machines, A1 and A2") ---
    "machines_A": ["A1", "A2"],

    # --- Step-B machines (text: "step B has three machines, B1, B2, and B3") ---
    "machines_B": ["B1", "B2", "B3"],

    # --- Processing time per unit product (hours) on each machine, from table.
    # Rows A1..B3, columns I, II, III.  Blank cells => product not allowed there.
    # A1: I=5, II=10, III=2+4=6
    "time_A1_I": 5.0,
    "time_A1_II": 10.0,
    "time_A1_III": 6.0,     # table shows "2+4"
    # A2: I=7, II=9, III=12
    "time_A2_I": 7.0,
    "time_A2_II": 9.0,
    "time_A2_III": 12.0,
    # B1: I=6, II=8, III blank
    "time_B1_I": 6.0,
    "time_B1_II": 8.0,
    # B2: I=4, II blank, III=11
    "time_B2_I": 4.0,
    "time_B2_III": 11.0,
    # B3: I=7, II blank, III blank
    "time_B3_I": 7.0,

    # --- Effective machine hours (column "Effective Machine Hours") ---
    "hours_A1": 6000.0,
    "hours_A2": 10000.0,
    "hours_B1": 4000.0,
    "hours_B2": 7000.0,
    "hours_B3": 4000.0,

    # --- Machine processing fee, yuan per hour (column "Machine Processing Fee /(元/h)") ---
    "fee_A1": 0.05,
    "fee_A2": 0.03,
    "fee_B1": 0.06,
    "fee_B2": 0.11,
    "fee_B3": 0.05,

    # --- Raw material cost, yuan per piece (row "Raw Material Cost/(元/件)") ---
    "raw_I": 0.25,
    "raw_II": 0.35,
    "raw_III": 0.50,

    # --- Selling price, yuan per piece (row "Selling Price/(元/件)") ---
    "price_I": 1.25,
    "price_II": 2.00,
    "price_III": 2.80,
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA

    m = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Sets
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    m.P = pyo.Set(initialize=d["products"], ordered=True)
    m.A = pyo.Set(initialize=d["machines_A"], ordered=True)
    m.B = pyo.Set(initialize=d["machines_B"], ordered=True)

    # Allowed (step-A machine, product) arcs, from the table's non-blank cells:
    # A1: I, II, III ; A2: I, II, III
    allowed_A = [("A1", "I"), ("A1", "II"), ("A1", "III"),
                 ("A2", "I"), ("A2", "II"), ("A2", "III")]
    # Allowed (step-B machine, product) arcs:
    # B1: I, II ; B2: I, III ; B3: I
    allowed_B = [("B1", "I"), ("B1", "II"),
                 ("B2", "I"), ("B2", "III"),
                 ("B3", "I")]
    m.arcA = pyo.Set(initialize=allowed_A, dimen=2)
    m.arcB = pyo.Set(initialize=allowed_B, dimen=2)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Variables: units of product p processed on machine (step A / step B)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    m.xA = pyo.Var(m.arcA, domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    m.xB = pyo.Var(m.arcB, domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    # Per-unit profit coefficient helper (revenue - raw material) per product.
    unit_margin = {
        "I": d["price_I"] - d["raw_I"],
        "II": d["price_II"] - d["raw_II"],
        "III": d["price_III"] - d["raw_III"],
    }
    fee_A = {"A1": d["fee_A1"], "A2": d["fee_A2"]}
    fee_B = {"B1": d["fee_B1"], "B2": d["fee_B2"], "B3": d["fee_B3"]}
    tA = {("A1", "I"): d["time_A1_I"], ("A1", "II"): d["time_A1_II"],
          ("A1", "III"): d["time_A1_III"],
          ("A2", "I"): d["time_A2_I"], ("A2", "II"): d["time_A2_II"],
          ("A2", "III"): d["time_A2_III"]}
    tB = {("B1", "I"): d["time_B1_I"], ("B1", "II"): d["time_B1_II"],
          ("B2", "I"): d["time_B2_I"], ("B2", "III"): d["time_B2_III"],
          ("B3", "I"): d["time_B3_I"]}

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Objective: maximize profit
    #   profit = sum over arcs [ (price - raw) * units - fee * time * units ]
    # The (price - raw) margin is earned once per finished product; to avoid
    # double counting across the A and B arcs, we charge the margin on the
    # step-B (finishing) arcs only, and charge machine fees on all arcs.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def obj_rule(mm):
        expr = 0
        for (mach, p) in mm.arcB:
            expr += unit_margin[p] * mm.xB[mach, p]
        for (mach, p) in mm.arcA:
            expr -= fee_A[mach] * tA[(mach, p)] * mm.xA[mach, p]
        for (mach, p) in mm.arcB:
            expr -= fee_B[mach] * tB[(mach, p)] * mm.xB[mach, p]
        return expr

    m.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.maximize)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Machine effective-hour capacity constraints
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def cap_A1(mm):
        return (tA[("A1", "I")] * mm.xA["A1", "I"]
                + tA[("A1", "II")] * mm.xA["A1", "II"]
                + tA[("A1", "III")] * mm.xA["A1", "III"]) <= d["hours_A1"]

    def cap_A2(mm):
        return (tA[("A2", "I")] * mm.xA["A2", "I"]
                + tA[("A2", "II")] * mm.xA["A2", "II"]
                + tA[("A2", "III")] * mm.xA["A2", "III"]) <= d["hours_A2"]

    def cap_B1(mm):
        return (tB[("B1", "I")] * mm.xB["B1", "I"]
                + tB[("B1", "II")] * mm.xB["B1", "II"]) <= d["hours_B1"]

    def cap_B2(mm):
        return (tB[("B2", "I")] * mm.xB["B2", "I"]
                + tB[("B2", "III")] * mm.xB["B2", "III"]) <= d["hours_B2"]

    def cap_B3(mm):
        return tB[("B3", "I")] * mm.xB["B3", "I"] <= d["hours_B3"]

    m.cap_A1 = pyo.Constraint(rule=cap_A1)
    m.cap_A2 = pyo.Constraint(rule=cap_A2)
    m.cap_B1 = pyo.Constraint(rule=cap_B1)
    m.cap_B2 = pyo.Constraint(rule=cap_B2)
    m.cap_B3 = pyo.Constraint(rule=cap_B3)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Flow balance: total units of each product leaving step A must equal
    # total units entering step B (each product must pass both steps).
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def bal_I(mm):
        return (mm.xA["A1", "I"] + mm.xA["A2", "I"]
                - mm.xB["B1", "I"] - mm.xB["B2", "I"] - mm.xB["B3", "I"]) == 0

    def bal_II(mm):
        return (mm.xA["A1", "II"] + mm.xA["A2", "II"]
                - mm.xB["B1", "II"]) == 0

    def bal_III(mm):
        return (mm.xA["A2", "III"] - mm.xB["B2", "III"]) == 0

    m.bal_I = pyo.Constraint(rule=bal_I)
    m.bal_II = pyo.Constraint(rule=bal_II)
    m.bal_III = pyo.Constraint(rule=bal_III)

    return m

    "routes": [

    "time_B": {
        ("B1", 1): 6,
        ("B2", 1): 4, ("B2", 2): 8, ("B2", 3): 11,
        ("B3", 1): 7,
    },

    # effective machine hours
    "cap_A": {"A1": 6000, "A2": 10000},
    "cap_B": {"B1": 4000, "B2": 7000, "B3": 4000},

    # machine processing fee (yuan/h)
    "fee": {"A1": 0.05, "A2": 0.03, "B1": 0.06, "B2": 0.11, "B3": 0.05},

    # raw material cost (yuan/unit)
    "mat": {1: 0.25, 2: 0.35, 3: 0.50},
    # selling price (yuan/unit)
    "price": {1: 1.25, 2: 2.00, 3: 2.80},
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    # ---- Sets ----
    model.I = pyo.Set(initialize=d["P"])                       # products
    model.A = pyo.Set(initialize=d["A_machines"])              # step A machines
    model.B = pyo.Set(initialize=d["B_machines"])              # step B machines
    model.R = pyo.Set(initialize=d["routes"], dimen=3)         # (product, A_machine, B_machine)

    # ---- Decision variables: units flowing along each allowed route ----
    model.x = pyo.Var(model.R, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    def unit_net(r):
        """Net profit per unit routed on route r (revenue - material - processing fees)."""
        p, a, b = r
        fee_a = d["fee"][a] * d["time_A"][(a, p)]
        fee_b = d["fee"][b] * d["time_B"][(b, p)]
        return d["price"][p] - d["mat"][p] - fee_a - fee_b

    # ---- Objective: maximize total net profit ----
    model.obj = pyo.Objective(
        expr=sum(unit_net(r) * model.x[r] for r in model.R),
        sense=pyo.maximize,
    )

    # ---- Step A capacity: sum over routes using machine a of time*x <= cap ----
    def rule_A(m, a):
        return sum(d["time_A"][(a, p)] * m.x[p, a, b]
                   for (p, aa, b) in m.R if aa == a) <= d["cap_A"][a]
    model.capA = pyo.Constraint(model.A, rule=rule_A)

    # ---- Step B capacity ----
    def rule_B(m, b):
        return sum(d["time_B"][(b, p)] * m.x[p, a, bb]
                   for (p, a, bb) in m.R if bb == b) <= d["cap_B"][b]
    model.capB = pyo.Constraint(model.B, rule=rule_B)

    return model

import pyomo.environ as pyo

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Decision variables
#   x[p, m] = number of units of product p processed on machine m
#     p in {"I","II","III"}, m in the set of machines allowed for p
#     domain: NonNegativeReals (continuous production quantities)
#
# Objective (maximize profit):
#   profit = sum over (p,m) of [ selling_price[p] - raw_material_cost[p]
#                                - processing_fee[m] * time[p,m] ] * x[p,m]
#
# Constraints
#   (1) Machine capacity: for each machine m,
#         sum over products p allowed on m of time[p,m] * x[p,m] <= effective_hours[m]
#   (2) Product balance: for each product p, the total quantity produced
#       (sum over machines) is the same variable set; no separate balance needed
#       because each x[p,m] is the quantity of p made via route m.
#       However, products II and III can only be processed on A2 in step A and
#       B2 in step B, so their allowed machine sets are restricted.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

DATA = {
    # products
    "products": ["I", "II", "III"],
    # machines
    "machines": ["A1", "A2", "B1", "B2", "B3"],
    # processing time per unit product (hours/unit); None means not allowed
    "time": {
        ("I", "A1"): 5,
        ("I", "A2"): 7,
        ("I", "B1"): 6,
        ("I", "B2"): 4,
        ("I", "B3"): 7,
        ("II", "A1"): 10,
        ("II", "A2"): 9,
        ("II", "B2"): 8,
        ("III", "A2"): 12,
        ("III", "B2"): 11,
    },
    # effective machine hours
    "effective_hours": {
        "A1": 6000,
        "A2": 10000,
        "B1": 4000,
        "B2": 7000,
        "B3": 4000,
    },
    # machine processing fee (yuan/hour)
    "processing_fee": {
        "A1": 0.05,
        "A2": 0.03,
        "B1": 0.06,
        "B2": 0.11,
        "B3": 0.05,
    },
    # raw material cost (yuan/unit)
    "raw_material_cost": {
        "I": 0.25,
        "II": 0.35,
        "III": 0.50,
    },
    # selling price (yuan/unit)
    "selling_price": {
        "I": 1.25,
        "II": 2.00,
        "III": 2.80,
    },
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    # Allowed (product, machine) pairs
    allowed_pairs = list(d["time"].keys())

    model.PAIRS = pyo.Set(initialize=allowed_pairs, dimen=2)

    # Decision variables: quantity of product p processed on machine m
    model.x = pyo.Var(model.PAIRS, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    # Objective: maximize total profit
    def obj_rule(m):
        total = 0
        for (p, mach) in allowed_pairs:
            unit_profit = (
                d["selling_price"][p]
                - d["raw_material_cost"][p]
                - d["processing_fee"][mach] * d["time"][(p, mach)]
            )
            total += unit_profit * m.x[p, mach]
        return total

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.maximize)

    # Constraint (1): machine capacity
    def capacity_rule(m, mach):
        expr = 0
        for (p, mm) in allowed_pairs:
            if mm == mach:
                expr += d["time"][(p, mm)] * m.x[p, mm]
        return expr <= d["effective_hours"][mach]

    model.capacity = pyo.Constraint(d["machines"], rule=capacity_rule)

    return model

    # Objective: maximize revenue - material cost - machine fees
    def revenue(m):
        return sum(d["price"][p] * m.prod_B[p, mb] for (p, mb) in pairs_B)

    def material(m):
        return sum(d["material_cost"][p] * m.prod_B[p, mb] for (p, mb) in pairs_B)

    def fees(m):
        fa = sum(d["fee_A"][ma] * d["time_A"][p, ma] * m.prod_A[p, ma]
                 for (p, ma) in pairs_A)
        fb = sum(d["fee_B"][mb] * d["time_B"][p, mb] * m.prod_B[p, mb]
                 for (p, mb) in pairs_B)
        return fa + fb

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(
        expr=revenue(model) - material(model) - fees(model),
        sense=pyo.maximize,
    )

    # Machine capacity constraints (step A)
    def cap_A_rule(m, ma):
        return sum(d["time_A"][p, ma] * m.prod_A[p, ma]
                   for (p, x) in pairs_A if x == ma) <= d["hours_A"][ma]
    model.cap_A = pyo.Constraint(model.MA, rule=cap_A_rule)

    # Machine capacity constraints (step B)
    def cap_B_rule(m, mb):
        return sum(d["time_B"][p, mb] * m.prod_B[p, mb]
                   for (p, x) in pairs_B if x == mb) <= d["hours_B"][mb]
    model.cap_B = pyo.Constraint(model.MB, rule=cap_B_rule)

    # Flow balance: units entering step A = units leaving step B for each product
    def balance_rule(m, p):
        inA = sum(m.prod_A[p, ma] for (q, ma) in pairs_A if q == p)
        outB = sum(m.prod_B[p, mb] for (q, mb) in pairs_B if q == p)
        return inA == outB
    model.balance = pyo.Constraint(model.P, rule=balance_rule)

    return model
